forWhat: Papers come in here, and you see where every answer on them stands: settled by the engine, checked by a person, or still waiting.

layout.shows: A box to drop a PDF or photos, a field for a Google Drive link, and the files read lately with [[Read again]].
Papers in, answers settled by the engine, answers checked by a person, answers waiting, papers to sign off.
Show by child, class or worksheet; Class; Status.
Class, Roll, Child, Paper, Waiting, Status, and the next step for each paper.
A link on to Class results.

jobs.title: Upload and read papers
steps: Photograph or scan the papers, in page order.
Drop the files in [[Choose scans or drop them here]], or paste a Google Drive link and press [[Read it]].
Each PDF is read on its own. Photos chosen together are read as one paper.
Every page is matched to its child by the code printed on it.
When reading is done, press [[Check answers]] for what the engine was not sure of.

jobs.title: A page with no code that can be read
steps: The file's row says which page had no code it could read.
Press the button with the child's name to say whose page it is. The page is then read as theirs.
The engine never guesses whose page it is.

buttons.label: Read it
buttons.does: Reads the scan at the Google Drive link you pasted.

buttons.label: Read again
buttons.doesNot: Answers a person has checked stay as they were left.
